and to_days(#{withdrawDateTo1}) >= to_days(t1.withdraw_date)
and t1.bp_name like concat('%',#{bpName},'%')

select t1.* from (SELECT 1 as seq_num, '第一季度' as quarter, nvl(sum(lcw.due_amount),0) as due_amount FROM LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW lcw WHERE LCW.WITHDRAW_STATUS='APPROVED' and LCW.COMPANY_ID=#{companyId} and Month(LCW.DUE_DATE) BETWEEN 1 and 3 and year(LCW.DUE_DATE) = year(sysdate) UNION SELECT 2 as seq_num, '第二季度' as quarter, nvl(sum(lcw.due_amount),0) as due_amount FROM LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW lcw WHERE LCW.WITHDRAW_STATUS='APPROVED' and LCW.COMPANY_ID=#{companyId} and Month(LCW.DUE_DATE) BETWEEN 4 and 6 and year(LCW.DUE_DATE) = year(sysdate) UNION SELECT 3 as seq_num, '第三季度' as quarter, nvl(sum(lcw.due_amount),0) as due_amount FROM LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW lcw WHERE LCW.WITHDRAW_STATUS='APPROVED' and LCW.COMPANY_ID=#{companyId} and Month(LCW.DUE_DATE) BETWEEN 7 and 9 and year(LCW.DUE_DATE) = year(sysdate) UNION SELECT 4 as seq_num, '第四季度' as quarter, nvl(sum(lcw.due_amount),0) as due_amount FROM LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW lcw WHERE LCW.WITHDRAW_STATUS='APPROVED' and LCW.COMPANY_ID=#{companyId} and Month(LCW.DUE_DATE) BETWEEN 10 and 12 and year(LCW.DUE_DATE) = year(sysdate) UNION SELECT 5 as seq_num, '年度总计' as quarter, nvl(sum(lcw.due_amount),0) as due_amount FROM LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW lcw WHERE LCW.WITHDRAW_STATUS='APPROVED' and LCW.COMPANY_ID=#{companyId} and year(LCW.DUE_DATE) = year(sysdate)) t1 order by T1.SEQ_NUM

SELECT lc.CONTRACT_NUMBER, HBM.BP_NAME as credit_bp_name, LCW.DUE_AMOUNT, lcq.COMPERHENSIVE_FINANCING_COST as INTEREST_RATE_OF_RETURN, lcw.DUE_DATE, lcw.WITHDRAW_END_DATE FROM LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW lcw, LON_CONTRACT lc, HLS_BP_MASTER hbm, LON_CONTRACT_QUOTATION lcq where LCW.WITHDRAW_STATUS='APPROVED' and lc.CONTRACT_ID=LCW.CONTRACT_ID and lc.CREDIT_BP_ID=HBM.BP_ID and lcq.WITHDRAW_ID = lcw.WITHDRAW_ID and lcw.COMPANY_ID=#{companyId} order by lcw.DUE_DATE desc
SELECT nvl(REPLACE(LPAD(MAX(SUBSTR(LCW.WITHDRAW_NUMBER, -2, 2)) + 1, 2, ' '), ' ', '0'), '01') FROM LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW LCW WHERE LCW.CONTRACT_ID=#{contractId}

SELECT nvl(HCL.ACTUAL_AVAILABLE_AMT,0)- nvl(CRE.DUE_AMOUNT,0)-nvl(CAPS.SUBSCRIBE_AMOUNT,0) AMOUNT FROM LON_CREDIT_LINE_CALC HCL LEFT JOIN ( SELECT LC.CREDIT_LINE_ID, nvl(SUM(ROUND((LCW.DUE_AMOUNT*nvl(LCW.EXCHANGE_RATE,1)),2)) ,0) DUE_AMOUNT FROM LON_CONTRACT LC JOIN LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW LCW ON LCW.CONTRACT_ID=LC.CONTRACT_ID WHERE LC.RELE_CREDIT_FLAG='Y' AND LCW.WITHDRAW_STATUS!='APPROVED' AND LCW.WITHDRAW_STATUS!='PENDING' AND LCW.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' GROUP BY LC.CREDIT_LINE_ID) CRE ON CRE.CREDIT_LINE_ID=HCL.CREDIT_LINE_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PS.CREDIT_LINE_ID, nvl(SUM(PS.SUBSCRIBE_AMOUNT),0) SUBSCRIBE_AMOUNT FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_SUBSCRIBE PS WHERE PS.SUBSCRIBE_STATUS='NEW' AND PS.RELE_CREDIT_FLAG='Y' GROUP BY PS.CREDIT_LINE_ID) CAPS ON CAPS.CREDIT_LINE_ID=HCL.CREDIT_LINE_ID WHERE HCL.CREDIT_LINE_ID=#{creditLineId}

SELECT LCW.* FROM LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW LCW WHERE LCW.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' -- AND LCW.WITHDRAW_STATUS='APPROVED'
AND LCW.CONTRACT_ID = #{contractId}
AND LCW.withdraw_number like concat(concat('%',#{withdrawNumber}),'%')
AND LCW.report_name like concat(concat('%',#{reportName}),'%')

select t.withdraw_id, t.change_time, t.change_reason, (case when t.CHANGE_TYPE = 'AI' then '手动调息' when t.CHANGE_TYPE = 'TE' then '交易要素变更' end) change_type, t.data_class, (select DESCRIPTION from SYS_USER su where su.USER_ID = t.CREATED_BY) description, (SELECT hds.description FROM hls_document_status hds WHERE hds.document_category = 'LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW' AND hds.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND hds.status_code = t.withdraw_status) withdraw_status_desc, t.withdraw_status, t.contract_id from lon_contract_withdraw t
t.DATA_CLASS = 'HISTORY'
and t.change_req_id =#{withdrawId}
ORDER BY t.withdraw_id DESC

SELECT r.BASE_RATE FROM fnd_base_rate_set s, fnd_base_rate r WHERE s.BASE_RATE_SET = r.BASE_RATE_SET AND ((s.VALID_FROM <= #{dueDate} AND s.VALID_TO >= #{dueDate}) OR ( s.VALID_FROM <= #{dueDate} AND s.VALID_TO is null)) AND r.DESCRIPTION = #{baseRateType} and rownum=1 order by r.creation_date desc

SELECT v.credit_line_amt - v.credit_exposure_amt AS surplus_credit FROM ( SELECT lcc.credit_line_amt, CASE
WHEN lcc.quota_type = 'REVOLVING' THEN ( SELECT nvl( SUM( LCW.DUE_AMOUNT ), 0 ) - nvl( SUM( LCW.WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT ), 0 ) FROM lon_contract_withdraw lcw, lon_contract lc WHERE lcw.contract_id = lc.contract_id AND lc.credit_contract_id = lcc.credit_contract_id AND lcw.data_Class = 'NORMAL' AND lcw.withdraw_status IN ( 'APPROVING', 'APPROVED', 'PENDING' ) ) ELSE ( SELECT nvl( SUM( LCW.DUE_AMOUNT ), 0 ) FROM lon_contract_withdraw lcw, lon_contract lc WHERE lcw.contract_id = lc.contract_id AND lc.credit_contract_id = lcc.credit_contract_id AND lcw.data_Class = 'NORMAL' AND lcw.withdraw_status IN ( 'APPROVING', 'APPROVED', 'PENDING' ) ) END AS credit_exposure_amt FROM lon_credit_contract lcc WHERE lcc.credit_contract_id = ( SELECT lc.credit_contract_id FROM lon_contract lc, lon_contract_withdraw lcw WHERE lc.contract_id = lcw.contract_id AND lcw.WITHDRAW_ID = #{withdrawId} ) ) v

SELECT min(lcr.TIMES+0) change_term FROM lon_contract_repayment lcr WHERE lcr.WITHDRAW_ID=#{withdrawId} and to_char(lcr.planned_calc_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') > to_char(#{rateChangeDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') and lcr.CF_ITEM='302' and rownum=1 order by lcr.TIMES+0 asc

select lcw.withdraw_id, lcw.contract_id, lcw.withdraw_number, lcw.change_version_id as change_version_id_n, (select lc.credit_bp_id from lon_contract lc where lc.contract_id = lcw.contract_id) as credit_bp_id, (select hbm.bp_name from lon_contract lc, hls_bp_master hbm where lc.contract_id = lcw.contract_id and lc.credit_bp_id = hbm.bp_id) as credit_bp_id_n, lcw.withdraw_name, lcw.withdraw_status, (select scvb.meaning from sys_code_value_b scvb, sys_code_b scb where scb.code = 'LON.CONTRACT_WITHDRAW_STATUS' and scb.code_id = scvb.code_id and scvb.enabled_flag = 'Y' and scvb.value = lcw.withdraw_status) as withdraw_status_n, lcw.change_status, (select scvb.meaning from sys_code_value_b scvb, sys_code_b scb where scb.code = 'LON.WITHDRAW_CHANGE_STATUS' and scb.code_id = scvb.code_id and scvb.enabled_flag = 'Y' and scvb.value = lcw.change_status) as change_status_n, ( CASE
WHEN lcw.change_status = 'APPROVED' THEN ( SELECT tt.WITHDRAW_ID FROM lon_contract_withdraw tt WHERE tt.WITHDRAW_NUMBER = lcw.WITHDRAW_NUMBER AND tt.CHANGE_VERSION_ID = lcw.CHANGE_VERSION_ID AND tt.DATA_CLASS = 'HISTORY' ) ELSE ( SELECT lcw2.withdraw_id FROM lon_contract_withdraw lcw2 WHERE lcw2.withdraw_id = lcw.CHANGE_REQ_ID ) END ) AS old_withdraw_id, ( CASE
WHEN lcw.change_status = 'APPROVED' THEN ( SELECT tt.contract_id FROM lon_contract_withdraw tt WHERE tt.WITHDRAW_NUMBER = lcw.WITHDRAW_NUMBER AND tt.CHANGE_VERSION_ID = lcw.CHANGE_VERSION_ID AND tt.DATA_CLASS = 'HISTORY' ) ELSE ( SELECT lcw2.contract_id FROM lon_contract_withdraw lcw2 WHERE lcw2.withdraw_id = lcw.CHANGE_REQ_ID ) END ) AS old_contract_id, lcw.change_type, (case when lcw.change_type = 'AI' then '调息' when lcw.change_type = 'TE' then '交易要素变更' end) as change_type_n, lcw.change_time, lcw.change_reason, lcw.created_by, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id = lcw.created_by) as created_by_n from lon_contract_withdraw lcw
lcw.data_class = 'CHANGE_REQ' and lcw.withdraw_number = #{withdrawNumber}
order by lcw.withdraw_id desc

select lcw.withdraw_id, (SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = lc.credit_bp_id) bp_name, lc.contract_number, lcw.withdraw_number, lcw.due_amount, lcw.withdraw_currency_code, (select fc.currency_name from fnd_currency fc where fc.currency_code = lcw.withdraw_currency_code) currency_n, lcw.due_date, (lcw.due_amount * 0.00005) stamp_duty_accrued_amount, lcw.post_flag from lon_contract_withdraw lcw inner join lon_contract lc on lc.contract_id = lcw.contract_id lcw.due_date >= to_date(#{dueDateFromL}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and lcw.due_date <= to_date(#{dueDateToL}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
and lcw.post_flag = #{postFlag}
and lcw.withdraw_number like concat('%', concat(#{withdrawNumber}, '%'))
and lc.contract_number like concat('%', concat(#{contractNumber}, '%'))
and (SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = lc.credit_bp_id) like concat('%', concat(#{bpName}, '%'))
